text: oh and, to be clear i just tested, without moving at all, but if i just hold down my mouse button painting, i dropped to 14 fps, so i think its all in the actual mouse down placement logic and not in any of the panning
resolution: Root-caused the hold-still paint fps cliff (240→14fps with mouse held, no camera movement): engine.zig paintGlobalCell set ch.dirty.flora/tiles/zones UNCONDITIONALLY on every stamp, so a held brush re-stamping identical cells each frame triggered a full live-foliage-preview regen (all painted chunks, 4.2M+ rows, ~63ms measured in the user's apptick-split) every frame. Fixed by change-gating all three cell channels — dirty only when the cell value actually differs — the same guard stampHeightsAt already had ('if (wrote)'). Committed 0d049271e; needs a framework rebuild to take effect. Remaining known cost (separate arc if still needed after retest): dragging onto genuinely NEW cells still regens the whole preview monolithically; the pose_mailbox off-thread pattern (req_2845) is the identified follow-up.
